phases.title: Intake
phases.chemistry: Raw water enters and is characterised in-situ by our in-house chemists before a single pipe is sized.

phases.title: Coagulation + Flocculation
phases.chemistry: The coagulant destabilises suspended particles; the flocculant binds them into settleable flocs.

metric.label: dose optimised per site → lower reagent spend

phases.title: Sedimentation
phases.chemistry: Flocs settle out as sludge in the clarifiers; clarified water moves on.

metric.label: energy-free separation — no pumps, no power draw

phases.title: Filtration
phases.chemistry: Multimedia + activated carbon filters strip residual solids and organics to discharge or reuse standard.

phases.title: Disinfection
phases.chemistry: UV, chlorine or ozone neutralise pathogens — chosen for the site, not by default.

phases.title: Sludge + Recovery
phases.chemistry: Sludge is dewatered and processed; valuable materials are salvaged from the stream.
